newsitem.title: UK: B.Aero, GEC firm as merger talk revives.
newsitem.headline: B.Aero, GEC firm as merger talk revives.

text.p: Shares in British Aerospace Plc gained seven pence to 1,365p after a U.K. newspaper report revived speculation of a merger with rival General Electric Co Plc, whose stock also firmed six pence to 344p.

The Guardian said senior British Aerospace executives were eyeing a link-up in the wake of the Socialist victory in France, which has cast doubts over the speed of the new government's privatisation plans.
These include St Nationale Industrielle Aerospatiale Thomson-CSF, where delay could slow wider consolidation within the European defence industry.
Speculation of a merger between the two British groups has been around for years, with talks earlier in the year apparently foundering on the issue of price.
Neither British Aerospace or GEC were immediately available for comment on the newspaper report.
